name: pair
description: Pair your Claude Code session with a colleague's using a one-time code, then let the two agents message each other, end-to-end encrypted. By Blackbeard Technologies.

hand_to_claude.title: Hand messages to Claude automatically
hand_to_claude.description: On: your colleague's messages and files go to Claude as they arrive. Off: they wait in the pair pane until you press → Claude (needs the pane; without it they always go to Claude).

default_trust.title: Default trust level
default_trust.description: What your colleague's requests may make Claude do without asking you, when you don't name a level as you pair. read-only: answer and read files, ask before anything else. ask: ask before anything. normal: Claude's usual judgement and your permission mode.
